scenes.vo: Last night, the girl outside my door had a peephole instead of a face.
In the morning, I called the management company. I asked about Nora, the girl who lived in nine C before me.
The man was quiet for a while. Then he said, Halden Building has EIGHT floors. There is no nine C. There never was.
Downstairs, I stepped into the elevator for the first time. I had always taken the stairs. The buttons went from one to EIGHT.
So I climbed back up, counting every floor out loud. Six. Seven. Eight. And the stairs kept GOING.
There were only eight floors. And I was standing on the NINTH.
